editorial.blurb: Dēliz Italian Steakhouse delivers refined Italian-American cuisine in an elegant setting where thoughtful service and standout dishes like pan brioche and perfectly-cooked steak create memorable occasions.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive for a date night or special celebration to enjoy the upstairs half indoor/outdoor ambience; request your own pan brioche appetizer rather than sharing—reviewers couldn't stop eating it.
